articles.title: Fadnavis orders probe into alleged donation irregularities at Siddhivinayak
articles.description: : Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered a comprehensive probe into alleged donation irregularities at the famous Siddhivinayak Temple in the city, directing officials to examine the shrine's records of the last five years, an official said on Saturday. The directive comes on the heels of allegations by Maharashtra Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray claiming Rs 18 crore was siphoned off annually from the temple, prompting the arrest of nine employees and Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde's demand for independent inquiries. According to officials, Fadnavis ordered a probe after a delegation from the Siddhivinayak Temple Trust met him and presented a detailed account of the collections between 2023-2026. The chief minister has sought the probe report at the earliest, they said. Last month, Shinde had sought an independent inquiry and instructed officials to begin the process. articles.title: Supreme Court to hear plea against order upholding rejection of waqf suits for non-payment of court fees
articles.description: The Supreme Court will hear a plea challenging a Gujarat High Court ruling. This ruling upheld the rejection of waqf suits for unpaid court fees. The high court relied on a previous decision stating waqf institutions must pay fees. The Ahmedabad Sunni Muslim Waqf Committee argues the Waqf Act exempts them from such payments. The apex court has issued a notice for a hearing within six weeks.

articles.title: JPSC Protest Enters Day 14: Students Demand Exam Cancellation, CBI Probe After First Talks With Govt
articles.description: Sonam Wangchuk has revealed that his wife Gitanjali tried to get Rahul Gandhi to offer him juice and help end his 26-day hunger strike at Jantar Mantar, but received no positive response. Wangchuk said the experience left him disappointed with Gandhi and other political leaders. He also accused Union ministers J P Nadda and Jitendra Singh of breaking a promise over photographs showing them offering him soup. Wangchuk further defended Gitanjali after her online backlash, saying she had also criticised the BJP and Hindutva forces but faced criticism after targeting Rahul Gandhi.
